snippet.title: Pure Pool Pro - Features Trailer | Native 8K Cue Sports Sim | Launches Feb 12 on PS5 & Steam
snippet.description:
Cue Sports: Redefined

Pure Pool Pro launches on 12th February 2026 for PlayStation 5 and Steam, with Xbox Series X|S and Epic Games Store versions to follow in Spring 2026.

From native 8K visuals* and high-fidelity reflections to career progression, challenge modes, online cross-play, and immersive venues, Pure Pool Pro delivers the most technically ambitious and authentic-feeling pool simulation to date - all powered using Ripstone’s proprietary Magma Engine.

Wishlist Now
- PlayStation: https://loom.ly/BypnXnE
- Steam: https://loom.ly/EjFY0sE
- Xbox (Spring 2026): https://loom.ly/xWEKoKA
- Epic Games Store (Spring 2026): https://loom.ly/xFBxojg

Key Features
- Native 8K 60fps visuals on PlayStation 5 Pro and high-end PC
- Native 4K 120fps performance mode on PS5, PS5 Pro, and PC
- Fully native rendering - no upscaling techniques used
- High-fidelity, software-based reflections
- Career modes across US 8-Ball and US 9-Ball, spanning hundreds of events
- Competitive online multiplayer with full cross-play
- Local multiplayer for couch competition
- Two iconic venues: the dramatic Tetradome and the atmospheric Rackhaus
- Deep customisation: cues, balls, baize designs, player cards, and profile crests
- Over 80 licensed music tracks 

Join the Community

- Chat with the developers and fellow players on Discord:
https://discord.gg/ripstone

Follow Pure Pool Pro:

- X (Twitter): https://twitter.com/PurePoolPro
- Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/purepoolpro.bsky.social
- TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@purepoolpro
- YouTube: @PurePoolPro

*Native 8K visuals only available on PlayStation 5 Pro and capable PC systems.
